mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_market_daily (symbol_id, trade_date, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, source, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{symbolId}, #{tradeDate}, #{openPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{closePrice}, #{volume}, #{source}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (symbol_id, trade_date) DO UPDATE SET close_price = EXCLUDED.close_price, source = EXCLUDED.source, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
